Claire / Marcus — I pulled together suggested technical language you can include in the DPA and an operational playbook summary below. Please consider these draft recommendations; Marcus / Laura, feel free to edit for commercial tone.

Suggested breach-notice language (draft):
- Initial notification: Redwood will notify the customer within 24 hours of detecting a security event that is reasonably likely to result in unauthorized access to PII. Notification will include a summary of the nature of the event, affected data categories, and immediate mitigation steps.
- Confirmed impact report: Redwood will provide a fuller technical report within 7 calendar days for interim findings and a final post-mortem within 30 calendar days, subject to reasonable extensions where forensic analysis is ongoing.
- Subprocessor notification: Redwood will notify customers within 24 hours of becoming aware of any subprocessor incident that materially affects customer data; Redwood will endeavour to provide details of the subprocessor and remedial actions.

Operational controls (summary):
- Data residency: We support regional pinning for model serving and log storage; production traffic can be constrained to us-central.
- Prompt handling: By default we persist minimal prompt metadata for debugging. Full request/response retention is 30 days by default for hosted plans; we can increase to 90 days for enterprise with contractual language. For MedBoard, we can set default logs to 90 days and provide a redaction option for raw prompt text on request.
- Access & logs: Access to logs is role-based, audited, and available via the Console. We can provide time-limited snapshots for your team and redacted dumps if preferred.
- Subprocessors: current list includes: CloudInfraCo (US), MetricsLoggers Inc (US), ModelHub (US). I will export a full vendor list with locations and contract links.

Relevant link: https://drive.google.com/redwood/soc2-evidence (contains certs & controls mapping).

If that aligns, Marcus — I can package these as a compact redline to your DPA and propose the 24-hour/7-day/30-day cadence above.
